sn23.15:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Rādho Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Dukkhaṃ dukkhanti bhante vuccati || || Katamannu kho bhante dukkhanti || || Rūpaṃ kho Rādha dukkhaṃ || vedanā dukkhā || saññā || saṅkhārā dukkhā || viññānaṃ dukkhaṃ || || Evam passaṃ || pe || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || ||
